spec.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import json,os,collections
from pathlib import Path
raw=json.loads(Path('store/jobs/j000019/out/uri_passwords.json').read_text())
items=raw if isinstance(raw,list) else [raw]
vals=[]
for x in items:
 h=x.get('password_utf8_hex') if isinstance(x,dict) else None
 if isinstance(h,str):
  try: vals.append(bytes.fromhex(h))
  except Exception: pass
lengths=collections.Counter(len(x) for x in vals)
out={'records':len(items),'usable_values':len(vals),'distinct_values_in_memory':len(set(vals)),'value_lengths':dict(sorted(lengths.items()))}
Path(os.environ['OUT'],'candidate-counts.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,sort_keys=True,indent=2))
print(json.dumps(out,sort_keys=True))
PY
